is a rare Hemomantic construct—an organic filament woven from blood and life force. It is neither fully alive nor entirely inert, and it pulses faintly like a heartbeat. Created through forbidden Hemomantic practices, the thread can bind, mend, and control living tissue.

A staple among master Hemomancers,
represents the fusion of flesh and craftsmanship, a perfect balance between creation and consumption. Those who wield it must understand its hunger—lest they become its next meal.

is a passive mechanic exclusive to members of the
faction. When casting spells that contain

affinity components, a portion of the mana cost is automatically converted into a blood cost instead. By default, 25% of the mana cost is replaced—the corresponding blood is drained at a ratio of 5 blood per 1 mana saved.

This allows Harbingers to stretch their mana reserves further by drawing upon their Hemomantic vitality, but careless casting can leave a Hemomancer dangerously drained of blood. If the caster lacks sufficient blood to pay the tithe, the full mana cost is charged as normal.
Blood Tithe values are configurable in the server config.
rewards Hemomancers who weave MnA spells and blood manipulations together in quick succession.
Granted after casting a blood-affinity MnA spell. While active, the blood cost of your next Hemomancy manipulation is reduced. The effect is consumed upon using a manipulation.

Granted after using a Hemomancy manipulation. While active, the mana cost of your next MnA spell is reduced. The effect is consumed when you cast that spell.

The intended loop is simple: cast a spell, use a manipulation, cast another spell, then use another manipulation. Each effect reduces the cost of the next action.
